product_demo.title: Full usage demo
product_demo.when_to_use: When you need to find or verify a person's email/phone, enrich a person or company into structured JSON, or answer free-form qualification questions about them with sources.

quickstart.goal: Find a verified work email from partial details
quickstart.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.sixtyfour sixtyfour.find_email '{"name":"Ada Lovelace","company":"acme.com"}'

examples.title: Full person enrichment
examples.goal: Source-backed profile from a seed email

examples.title: Agentic QA on an entity
examples.goal: Answer free-form qualification questions with sources
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.sixtyfour sixtyfour.qa '{"company":"acme.com","question":"Do they sell to enterprises?"}'

operations.note: each contact-discovery call spends 1 of your 50 requests

cost.worked_total: Metered in requests, not dollars: this demo spends 5 of your 50 free requests. At 0 remaining, calls return 402.

gotchas: Quota is 50 REQUESTS per Pilot user, not a dollar budget — every enrichment/discovery call spends 1.
402 Payment Required means your 50 free requests are used up.
Every returned field is source-backed — inspect the sources[] before trusting a value.
deep_search is async: it returns a task_id and results are retrieved separately.
Provide as many seed details as you have (name + company, email, domain) for higher-confidence hits.

description: Sixtyfour is the app-store front door for the Sixtyfour people-intelligence and company-intelligence API. It gives an agent contact discovery (find email / find phone), reverse lookups from an email or phone, full person and company enrichment, and an agentic QA researcher that answers free-form questions about a person or company. All returned as clean structured JSON, every field source-backed.
